article.story: FLORENCE, Ala. -- — Cortez Graham-Howard’s 14 points helped North Alabama defeat Alabama A&M 77-74 on Tuesday night. Graham-Howard shot 5 for 7, including 4 for 5 from beyond the arc for the Lions (5-2). Damarien Yates scored 13 points while going 5 of 9 from the field, and added three steals. Drey Carter had 12 points and shot 3 of 8 from the field and 6 for 6 from the free-throw line. James Graham led the way for the Bulldogs (4-3) with 26 points. Devin Brown added 12 points and nine rebounds for Alabama A&M. Sami Pissis finished with 12 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
